name: Drider
summary: A drow-spider monstrosity that strikes with its forelegs and venom.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the drider has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on ability checks and attack rolls.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

bonusActions.name: Magic of the Spider Queen
bonusActions.text: The drider casts *{ref:spell/darkness}*, *{ref:spell/faerie-fire}*, or *{ref:spell/web}*, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {dc:str}).
